title: arxiv_2204.04143v1
universal_lens: SVM and Adaboost classifiers integrate edge detection and shape information for player classification in team sports video analysis. Silhouette-based shape invariants enable robust tracking through aspect ratios and compactness measures, decoupling motion from deformation.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference models classify player vs non-player objects using SVM-trained likelihood functions over edge-detected frames. Bayesian inference on silhouette invariants enables probabilistic tracking of players and ball via shape descriptors and compactness thresholds.
gse_mapping: Situationally-aware state transitions track player positions via particle filtering and PDM-based point matching across video frames. Situational reasoning maps silhouette shape transitions to state-space trajectories using graph-based pathfinding and temporal consistency checks.
